relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: galcanezumab demonstrated effectiveness in episodic cluster headache, but a lack of effectiveness in chronic cluster headache

key_findings: Scoping review of 56 studies (45 RCTs) of acute and preventive cluster headache therapies.
Galcanezumab was effective in episodic but not chronic cluster headache, and fremanezumab was ineffective, so CGRP antibodies show no class effect.
